title: Realizing Saddle-Node Bifurcations from Finite Data
summary: Given a finite set of data generated by an unknown ordinary differential equation it is impossible to exactly determine the associated vector field, and hence, bifurcation theory tells us that it is impossible, in general, to correctly characterize the underlying dynamics. In this paper, we bypass the effort of obtaining an analytic approximation of the vector field, and we adopt an approach based on Occam's razor: identify the simplest robust characterization of the dynamics that is compatible with the given data.
